module.title: Tracy design system
module.why: header-r is the first module position of both header blocks (header-1, header-2: every layout), rendered raw; the slot is parsed before every element under it, so nothing paints in the template's look first and then transitions (measured 09/10: in `footer` the landing CTA kept the template's blue — its transition:all ran from the first paint)

modesNote: the template has a light/dark switch ([data-tracy-theme-toggle]; js/darkmode.js sets data-theme, data-bs-theme and html.t4-dark together, index.php sets them before paint): the module sheet writes the system's own side under the template's matching mode and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs, src/sides.mjs, keyed on data-theme), and does not hide the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2). Tracy Airbnb, the same template under another element, inherits it
specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every template rule, below an element's own inline style.
brandNote: re-measured 12/10/2026 with every heading and text judged: the landing's third- and fourth-rank text (--brand-color-text-tertiary and -quaternary, both the template's meta grey, 3.51-3.62:1 on its own white) took each system's meta (the fourth a lighter mix of it), made to be faint (Moxie 2.11:1, MotherDuck 2.63, Toggl Track 2.46, Apple 2.15): it takes the system's muted. The highlighted card's ground (--brand-color-primary-bg) is the template's surface again, not a 10% accent tint, where the system's muted read 4.16-4.43:1. The star rating's warning yellow (1.92:1 on the template's white) is mixed a third toward the system's text, so it darkens on a light page and lightens on a dark one (Apple 1.76:1 before). 15/10/2026: the landing's ground (--brand-color-bg-layout) is the page (var(--bg)), as the published template's own native-landing.css sets it; the system's surface there drew the landing as a #212121 block between a #141414 header and body (Figma dark) and #f5f5f5 against white (light). The ten accent steps (--brand-primary-palette-1 to -10, the hero chart bars) are the system's accent moved toward the page (steps 1 to 5) and toward the text (7 to 10), step 6 the accent: light to dark on a light page and dark to light on a dark one, like the template's own two ramps; never derived, they stayed the template's Apple blue under every system
sideNote: Tracy Base (tracy-base/j6 1.0.4, preview measured 16/10/2026): its scene bands (.tracy-band--scene) are the ink band, black on the template's light page and flush with its black page in its dark look (1.00:1). On a dark side the system's ink is a lifted surface (Moxie dark #1a1a1a on #000000, 1.21:1, GROUND-2): there they take the system's page and its text colour, as the template's dark look keeps them. On a light side the chapter's support line in a scene band took the system's muted, made for a light page (#595959 on black, 3.0:1 under refero 5fd3b3b4): it is the band's own words mixed toward its ink. Tracy Apple 1.3.1 (16/10/2026, built-site run at probe v9): its scene bands read the system's ink as Tracy Base's do, so the rules 1.3.0 needed for a band that stayed black (the support line the template's #86868b, the action line and secondary button the accent itself) read 1.43:1 on Airbnb's grey ink (#6d6d6d) and 3.02-3.97:1 on the darker inks (Stripe, Pitch, Figma, Apple, Voiceflow): in a scene band on a light side the action line and the secondary button take the band's own words (on-ink) and the support line is those words mixed 10% toward the ink (Airbnb's grey ink: 4.85:1; the 60% mix read 2.6:1 there), which also holds on 1.3.0's black band. On a dark side the feature cards' text (muted on a lifted card) read 3.62-4.49:1 under Moxie, Spotify, Linear and every derived dark side (the template's own is higher): it is the muted mixed halfway toward the page text. T4's link variables (--body-link-color and its hover, the main menu's hover and active) read the readable accent: the accent fill painted the category list's subcategory titles #6786c4 on #eae5cc under Moxie (2.87:1, CON-2).
formTokensNote: Tracy Base sizes every .btn from --tracy-capsule-pad, which the slot sets from the system's button padding: inside a form it is the template's own value (css/styles/base.css), so a field's button keeps the field's 44px (Moxie: 34px beside 44px fields on sign-in, search and contact, LAYOUT-3, 16/10/2026). Tracy Apple shares this contract; its own value was not measured here.
followNote: Tracy Apple's page modules (tracy-apple/j6 1.3.0, re-measured 12/10/2026 with every heading and text judged): the hero and features eyebrows, the chapter's action line and the secondary buttons paint the accent as text (MotherDuck's light blue 1.62-1.94:1): they take the readable accent; the plan card's badge is muted on a grey chip (3.73:1 on the template, 3.46 under MotherDuck): it takes the page text. On a light worn page the black chapter band (#t4-section-4) keeps the accent itself for its action line and secondary button (the readable accent is made for a light page: 3.79:1 on that black under MotherDuck), and its support line, which took the system's muted (3.88:1 on black, the template's own 4.14), is the template's lighter grey (#86868b), and the green success badge a deeper green (2.31:1 on MotherDuck's chip, the template's own 2.63)
landingNote: native-landing.css (the brand-engine landing) sizes h1/h2, tracking, leading, the CTA capsule and section rhythm from template tokens with !important; the CTA weight is a literal 400 !important, so the slot's button weight is the one rule written !important — where the template already forces it
